primary_cases: All eligible known-correction-part pairs whose original occurrence year is 2025; same frozen temporal/chain rules.
sensitivity_rule: Original SubmissionDate strictly greater than the latest 2024-selection outcome SubmissionDate; report overlap, never silently omit it from primary results.
interval: 95% percentile original-report cluster bootstrap; undefined answered accuracy remains null.
rq4_comparators: answer every nonempty terminal ranking without confidence/evidence gates
notes: Abstention-off is an explicit diagnostic counterfactual; it is not silently installed.
No tuning, threshold sweeps, refitting or new vocabulary after held-out access.
Report all part-change strata, source fingerprints, discarded pairs, missing labels and temporal availability.
Expose poor results, sensitivity overlap and relative-support wording.
execution_gate: Synthetic/full-stack CI must succeed on the exact head before the one-shot run-frozen-held-out label event.
abstention_off_terminal_definition: Use identical chosen-policy terminal beliefs and questions; remove only final confidence/evidence answer gates.
historical_exposure_note: The legacy Mid-I ranker was developed with an earlier 2025 POC; this is a frozen-configuration temporal benchmark, not a claim of project-wide blind exposure.
history_restoration_rule: Reconstruct only the original frozen identifier set/order, then require the unchanged complete canonical projection hash. Archive the retrieved revision; added rows cannot enter the frozen history. Missing/changed frozen content fails before test access.
